description: This file contains shell script code to test git hooks and push operations, including setup for a 'proc-receive' hook, executing a push command, and verifying output and references.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a test hook for the proc-receive event.

methods.name: test-tool proc-receive
methods.description: Executes the proc-receive command with verbose output.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to make it more readable and consistent.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output to the expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares branch and reference states between repositories.
